Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-screen visual novel background for an original desktop game set in a ruined supernatural Three Kingdoms world. Create one 16:9 landscape illustration, 2048x1152 if possible. Hand-painted mature East Asian historical fantasy game background, carefully composed perspective, detailed realistic painterly architecture and atmospheric depth, ink-green distant land, warm ochre light, old stone and weathered timber. Eye-level camera, no aerial map. Full bleed environment only. Keep the lower third and left/right foreground calm so large transparent character portraits and a bottom dialogue panel can overlay it. No people or foreground characters, no UI, no frame, no collage, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no modern technology or Western buildings. This is a reusable story scene, not a promotional poster.
Scene: a deserted old road outside ruined Xu Province in late afternoon, dry reeds and grass by worn stone paving, low broken Han-era walls and a damaged watch gate in the middle distance, distant blue-green mountains and a faint ruined town along the horizon. Open road in the center, broad empty foreground for two conversing characters. Solemn yet expansive sunlight, restrained copper and green colors. No battle, gore, soldiers, or ominous monster in foreground.

Scene: an uncanny but inhabited-feeling old Chinese night market lane among decaying Han-era eaves, quiet stalls bearing cloth bundles, herb baskets, old ceramic pots and small wooden chests, dim amber paper lanterns. No visible people. A receding stone lane in the center with ghostly green-grey haze at the far end. Small warm pools of lantern light balanced with deep desaturated green shadows. Foreground clear for character portraits; architecture and lanterns carry the scene's detail above the dialogue area. No bright neon, no readable shop signs.

Scene: a captured, weathered mountain stockade courtyard at dusk, broken timber palisade, rough gate and tiled abandoned hall behind, a modest campfire glow and a few stacked grain sacks at the side, an old stone well visible in the midground. No people, no displayed dead bodies. Open flat courtyard foreground to stage two character portraits. Blue-green mountains beyond the palisade, quiet warm torchlight and desaturated night sky, a temporary refuge in a ruined land. The courtyard and well must read clearly rather than a busy battlefield.
